root.title: Aeterna
root.tagline: From tested engine to a simulator that plays like Aegis
root.waitingHtml: Waiting on you: nothing. The god-icon check is done (official site for BS68, Fandom for BS69–BS72); no UI change is waiting for approval.
root.next: next: compiler v2 prototype (clause-level: target + action sentences; Opus), then the Standard block A import (owner present for the browser); 608 of 8,041 cards playable

phase.name: Engine foundation
phase.sub: The rules core the whole game stands on.

items.t: Eternal turn flow, all 7 steps
Cores: Reserve, Void (unlimited), Trash, Soul Core
Summon, mandatory cost reduction by symbols, Nexus
Attack, block, BP battle, Life damage
Burst and Advent
Win checks: Life 0, deck out
Seeded RNG, replays, scenarios

Starting-Hand redraw with a Contract card (owner report 2026-10-17, v0.59.1): JP 17.1 and EN 17.0 manuals confirm the redraw returns it and it cannot be added again; the dialog now says so, the CPU keeps a hand with its Contract card

phase.name: Card content
phase.sub: Real cards in, so decks stop being placeholders.

items.t: JSON card schema + import
Import your own card images
Deck text import / export
Saga 15–17 pack: 63 red and white cards from card images
Fandom reference data BS01–BS77 (8,158 rows) in the repo
Image index per Saga folder (name → file)
Bulk card intake tool: 7,978 cards staged in data/import (v0.36)
Game pack grew from 63 to 126 cards with four colour decks (v0.37–v0.40)
Data check BS74–BS76 against Fandom (v0.41.2, issue #5)
Data check of green, purple, yellow decks against Fandom (v0.41.3); 14 god-icon conflicts open
Gold icon = Ultimate reduction symbol, mapped on import (v0.41.5)
Every Saga 1–17 card playable

phase.name: Card data intake
phase.sub: From raw data to a playable card, the same way every time.

items.t: Compact, compressed card pack: all 8,041 cards fit the single file (1.16 MB, phone-like load 2.3 s) (v0.51.0)
Effect compiler: card text to effects + smoke-checked promotion (v0.52.0, 347 cards)
Raw data
items.d: Fandom card lists BS01–BS77 (data/sources/fandom-cards-bs01-bs77.json): name, type, colour, cost, reduction, symbols, families, levels, effect text. Owner decision: this export is the main source.

items.t: Image index
items.d: Your folders Card Asset\<Saga>\images mapped name → file (data/index/saga_card_index.json).

items.t: Merge and clean (v0.36)
items.d: tools/import_fandom.py writes data/import/saga-NN.json + report.json: 7,978 cards, 110 duplicate numbers merged, 453 without an image, 6 number conflicts reported. Staging only, so unchecked cards never enter index.html.

items.t: Check against the image
items.d: Images are read only where the export lacks data or looks wrong, one colour deck at a time (60–80 cards, cropped corners, about 20 per contact sheet). Stats of the four new decks are not image-checked yet (issue #5). God reduction icons settled without images in v0.44.6–v0.44.7 (25 deck cards).

items.t: Into the game
items.d: tools/promote_import.py moves a colour deck's verified cards into data/cards (never overwrites). Stats are playable at once; text not yet wired shows as residual.

items.t: Wire the effects
items.d: Per colour release: blue, green, purple and yellow are done. Magic cards of all colours, Ultra Advent / Ultimate cards and a list of per-card gaps remain.

items.t: Test and ship
items.d: Each release: data and card tests, CPU-vs-CPU sims with the new deck, Regression on GitHub, size and time guard rails (v0.36.1).

items.t: Batch promotion per Saga: new compiler patterns from the review list (v0.54.0: +62 cards, 561 / 8,041; about 2 cards per new pattern, so it continues as filler)
Engine levers for the long tail (v0.55.0: BP minus, (When Destroyed by the Opponent), (When Battles) battle win, Rush; +12 cards, 573 / 8,041; no BP-0 destruction rule, FAQ p. 68)

Rules audit R1-R2 (v0.55.1, owner request): sources and versions table (JP Eternal 17.1 of 2026-05-29, JP 17.0 revision notice, Standard 1.1 / CR 1.0), tools/rules_audit.py -> docs/reports/rules-audit.md: 242 items, 77 confirmed, 48 house reading, 5 conflict, 112 open; 30-day check in session_start

Rules audit R3 fixes (Opus): Burst resolves after all non-Burst triggered effects (JP 17.0 item 6) v0.55.2; Standby state (item 4) v0.57.0; effect priority cannot > must > do = can with session E (item 9) v0.58.0

Ultimate cards in the compiler (v0.56.0): Sumcon summon conditions (summonIf ctrl/lifeGe), LV3+ level check, Ultimate Trigger action ULT_TRIGGER; 0 cards promoted (the Fandom export drops the [LVn] (timing) line of 110 Ultimate Trigger cards)

Ultimate Trigger [LVn] (timing) for 110 cards from live Fandom pages (session with the owner present: Fandom pages need an approval prompt), then compile and promote (measured in v0.59.0: only ~1 card compiles after that, the bodies need other sentences)
Ultimates as targets measured (v0.59.0): 0 real unlocks alone; step-prefixed attack triggers instead (OPP_ATTACKS, ally family attacks, that Spirit +BP): +4 cards, 593 / 8,041
Brave completion part 1 (v0.60.0): combine data for 287 Braves from the Fandom pages, braved effects on the combined Spirit: +15 cards, 608 / 8,041
Priority report + Fandom data gaps (v0.60.3): newest cards first; Nexus levels and Ultimate Trigger lines

phase.name: Effect engine
phase.sub: Cards do what their text says.

items.t: Triggers: summoned, attacks, blocks, destroyed, revealed, ally events
Targeting and choice dialogs
Flash timing window in battle
Magic cards (Main and Flash), Burst through the engine
"By doing X, do Y", Once per Turn, same-name keys
Simultaneous triggers: the turn player orders them, derived effects first (v0.28, rule TRIGGER-ORDER)
Effect priority: "cannot" beats "must" beats "may" (v0.58.0, with Armor / Heavy Armor / Ultra Armor "unaffected")
Effects for the four colour decks, gaps listed per card (v0.37–v0.40)

Burst then pay to use the Flash effect; Magma Call extra Red symbol and Ometeotl repeat (v0.44.0)
Effects for the rest of Saga 1–17

Playmat, hand, phase bar, popups
Main menu, card library, deck builder with search
Card zoom with your own art, images in every zone
Game log, rules coverage page, settings, speed, sound

phase.name: Repo and quality (Aegis study 2)
phase.sub: A tidy repo and tools that catch bugs before a player does.

items.t: C1+C2 (v0.59.2-v0.59.3): docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, doc index, doc-convention skill, reports in docs/reports/, mechanic records in docs/mechanics/
Q1 (v0.59.4-v0.59.6): strict effects mode, in-game error report with replay, match fuzzer (tools/fuzz.mjs)
C5 (v0.59.7): short front page like Aegis; release notes to CHANGELOG.md and the Releases page (workflow), game file on each release
F1 (v0.59.8): match fuzzer in the Regression workflow (20 fuzzed matches per run, failing seeds as artifacts)
S1 (v0.60.2): faster sessions: one release per session, Regression not awaited (10 sims patch / 30 minor), subagents for tests and checks
Q2: UI tests wait on state instead of fixed sleeps (318 to 0)
Q3: rules knowledge base with fingerprinted citations (no full manual text in the public repo)
Q4: one-card verification skill

phase.name: Online + offline platform
phase.sub: One engine for the offline file and an online server; no hosting until the owner decides.

items.t: M1 (v0.60.1): workspace skeleton (packages/engine, apps/web), byte-identical build
M2-M3 host port: render and player choices through io.view / io.decide
M4 replays: input record + viewer replay
UI languages: string table, then Japanese, Thai, Chinese, more by market; card text stays English
M5 types (ts-check first)
M6 server, M7 Postgres + Docker (local and CI), M8 online client

phase.name: Road to playable (estimate, 18 Oct 2026)
phase.sub: Owner, 2026-10-18: newest cards first (Standard block A, then Eternal newest Saga), whole decks per colour; no manual mode. Session counts are rough and are re-estimated after the compiler v2 measurement.

items.t: Alpha: playable vs CPU on PC and Android with ready colour decks (608 of 8,041 cards)
Data gaps (v0.60.3): Nexus levels for 717 cards, Ultimate Trigger lines for 119 from Fandom (0 unlocks alone)

Standard block A import (~700 card numbers, 26R sets), compiled with v2, promoted colour by colour
Beta: 40 playable cards per colour in Standard and in the newest Eternal Saga, public link
v1.0: every card playable (8,041): needs v2 and keyword heads first
